title: Gahl-Mills, Baggetta to serve as co-directors of the O’Neill Center for Leadership in Public Service
summary_en: Karen Gahl-Mills and Matthew Baggetta named co-directors of the O’Neill Center for Leadership in Public Service, advancing ethical leadership and civic engagement.
